model_policy.complex: Use the strongest available reasoning model when the execution environment allows model choice.
model_policy.moderate: Use stronger reasoning for cross-file behavior, quality-gate, or template contract changes when available.
model_policy.simple: Use the default model unless verification fails.

subagent_policy.complex: Dispatch only taskgraph-selected waves; split implementer work only when dependencies and resource sets are disjoint, then keep one integration owner.
subagent_policy.moderate: Keep implementation in the primary agent and run explicit reviewer and verifier passes.
